player_prompt.intro:
Ya rɛn Blackjack kuɛr dealer.
Yin bɛn ë kuɛr tiɛm 21 kɛn bɛn kuɛr.
Yin rɛn, ŋɛn '[Hit]' kɛn rɛn kuɛr kɛn '[Stand]' kɛn rɛn.
J/Q/K = 10 tiɛm; A = 11 kɛn 1, ee bɛn kuɛr.
